short_description: Enterprise medical billing platform with integrated EHR, optional managed RCM services, and advanced analytics for multi-specialty practices.
long_description: AdvancedMD Medical Billing is the revenue cycle management component of the AdvancedMD healthcare software suite, now owned by Global Payments. The billing platform provides comprehensive RCM capabilities including electronic claims submission, real-time eligibility verification, ERA auto-posting, denial management, and patient billing. AdvancedMD offers both self-service billing (where practices manage their own claims) and fully outsourced RCM services (where AdvancedMD's team handles the entire revenue cycle). The platform includes AI-powered analytics and dashboards that identify revenue leakage and optimization opportunities. Integration with Global Payments provides seamless patient payment processing. AdvancedMD serves over 40,000 providers across multiple specialties including behavioral health, making it a strong choice for larger practices wanting a unified platform for EHR, practice management, and billing with optional outsourcing.

faqs.q: How much does AdvancedMD billing cost per month?
faqs.a: AdvancedMD billing starts around $429-529/month per provider for the PM and billing module. Full suite with EHR runs $729-929/month per provider. Managed RCM services (full outsourcing) typically cost 4-8% of collected revenue. Bundle discounts are available.

faqs.q: Does AdvancedMD offer managed billing services?
faqs.a: Yes, AdvancedMD offers fully outsourced RCM services where their team handles claims submission, denial management, AR follow-up, and patient billing. This service typically costs 4-8% of collected revenue and is ideal for practices wanting hands-off billing management.

faqs.q: Is AdvancedMD owned by Global Payments?
faqs.a: Yes, AdvancedMD was acquired by Global Payments (NYSE: GPN) in 2018. This provides AdvancedMD with the backing of a major payments company, enhanced payment processing capabilities, and enterprise-level resources and stability.

faqs.q: Does AdvancedMD work for behavioral health practices?
faqs.a: AdvancedMD supports behavioral health billing and includes mental health-specific features. However, as a multi-specialty platform, it may not offer the same therapy-focused workflows as dedicated mental health solutions like SimplePractice or TherapyNotes. Larger behavioral health groups may find value in AdvancedMD's comprehensive features.
